pseudoAds: AI Engineer / LLM Engineer. We are looking for an engineer to build and ship LLM-powered features: multi-agent pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling and structured outputs. You will design evaluation harnesses to measure model quality, work with providers like Anthropic, OpenAI and Gemini as well as self-hosted open models, and own features end to end from prototype to production. Experience with LangGraph or similar orchestration frameworks, Python and a modern web stack is a strong plus. Visa sponsorship available.

Senior Full-Stack Engineer (TypeScript). Join our product team building web applications with Next.js, React and Node.js. You will own features across the stack: database schema (PostgreSQL, Prisma), API design, server-side rendering and polished frontends. We value engineers who ship complete, tested, documented work and can operate independently. Relocation support and visa sponsorship offered.

Python Developer / Backend Engineer. We need a backend engineer to build FastAPI services, background job pipelines and integrations with third-party APIs. You will work with PostgreSQL, Redis and Docker, write tests with pytest, and deploy through CI/CD. Full-stack ability with a JavaScript frontend framework is welcome. International candidates encouraged; we sponsor work permits.

Unity Developer (C#). Mobile game studio seeks an experienced Unity developer for gameplay programming, UI systems and performance optimization across iOS and Android. You have shipped multiple titles, profile and optimize for low-end devices, and collaborate closely with artists and designers. Experience with casual and hybrid-casual games is a plus. Visa sponsorship and relocation package available.

Software Engineer (C# / .NET). We build our platform on C# and .NET. You will design and maintain services, write clean object-oriented code following SOLID principles, and work in an agile team with code review and CI. A decade of production C# experience across different domains is exactly the profile we want. We support international hires with visa sponsorship.

Technical Product Manager / Producer. We are hiring a technically fluent product manager to coordinate engineering, design and art toward scheduled releases. You have hands-on software development background, can read code and estimate scope credibly, run agile ceremonies, and communicate clearly with stakeholders and external clients. Game production experience is a strong plus.

AI Quality / Evaluation Engineer. Help us measure and improve our AI systems. You will build evaluation pipelines: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring, seeded-defect tests, A/B replays and regression suites that gate releases. Strong Python, careful experimental methodology and honest reporting of negative results matter more than any specific framework. Visa sponsorship available.
